capabilities: convert the current Markdown note to a .tex file via a ribbon command
compile the generated .tex file to PDF when automatic conversion is enabled
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export notes as LaTeX documents or compile them to PDF.

requires.name: command line LaTeX compiler such as pdflatex

summary: Converter that turns the current Markdown note into a .tex LaTeX file, optionally compiling it to PDF via a command-line LaTeX compiler.
